newsitem.title: USA: Value Line settles lawsuit, to buy shares.
newsitem.headline: Value Line settles lawsuit, to buy shares.

text.p: Value Line Inc said that Arnold Bernhard & Co Inc, owner of about 80 percent of the outstanding common stock of Value Line Inc., has signed an agreement that settles a lawsuit pending in the New York State Supreme Court that seeks to dissolve AB & Co.

As part of that agreement, and on the fulfillment of the conditions, AB&Co. will purchase on Jan. 2 the shares of AB & Co common stock held by the Arnold Van Hoven Bernhard family and two co-trustees of a trust of which he is the income beneficiary.

The acquisition of AB&Co. shares may be funded in part from internal resources and in part from borrowings, or from the declaration of an extraordinary Value Line Inc. dividend payable to all Value Line Inc. shareholders. No decision has been made as yet with respect to the funding or whether, or when, there may be a declaration of an extraordinary dividend, or the amount thereof. If AB&Co. asks Value Line to declare an extraordinary dividend, such action may only be taken by the board of directors of Value Line Inc. Jean Bernhard Buttner, chairman and chief executive officer of AB&Co. and Value Line Inc. owns a majority of the voting stock of AB&Co. and will own all of such voting stock following consummation of the settlement agreement.
Value Line is a leading New York-based investment publishing and investment management company.
